rate.label: Rate
rate.notes: Positive target units per source unit. Null on a custom version returns the pair to automatic rates. Write through the currency-rate adapter, which validates this invariant.

observation_date.label: Observation Date
observation_date.notes: Optional provider observation provenance, distinct from the effective date.

ref.label: Employee Ref
ref.notes: Unique employee reference. Often an internal HRIS number like EMP-001 or alphanumeric ID.

name.label: Full Name
name.notes: Employee's full display name, typically "First Last".

known_aliases.label: Known Aliases
known_aliases.notes: Confirmed alternate employee names used for deterministic import matching.

employment_status.label: Employment Status
employment_status.notes: Current employment state: active, terminated, on leave, etc.

title.label: Job Title
title.notes: The employee's current job title, e.g. "Senior Software Engineer", "VP Sales".

department.label: Department
department.notes: Organizational department the employee belongs to: Engineering, Sales, Marketing, etc.

location.label: Work Location
location.notes: Office or work site. Often a city or office name like "SF HQ", "Remote - US", "New York"

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.notes: Hire date or employment start date.

end_date.label: Termination Date
end_date.notes: Last day of employment. Null if currently active.

base_salary.label: Base Salary
base_salary.notes: Annual base salary. Currency amount, often with $ or /yr.

target_bonus.label: Target Bonus
target_bonus.notes: Annual target bonus amount or percentage of base.

target_commission.label: Target Commission
target_commission.notes: Annual target commission amount. Typically for sales roles.

country.label: Country
country.notes: Country of employment as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

birth_date.label: Date of Birth
birth_date.notes: Employee's date of birth. Expect values on or before 2008.

name_display.label: Preferred Name
name_display.notes: Preferred or display name if different from legal name.

comp_zone.label: Compensation Zone
comp_zone.notes: Geographic compensation zone for pay banding.

job_family.label: Job Family
job_family.notes: Job family grouping: Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, etc.

gender.label: Gender
gender.notes: Male, Female, Non-binary, or other gender identifiers.

cost_center.label: Cost Center
cost_center.notes: Financial cost center code for budgeting. Often a numeric code.

wfh_policy.label: Work From Home Status
wfh_policy.notes: Remote work policy: Remote, Hybrid, In-Office, etc.

option_set.label: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

regrettable_classification.label: Regrettable Classification
regrettable_classification.notes: Whether the departure was regrettable or non-regrettable.

pay_frequency.label: Pay Frequency
pay_frequency.notes: How often paid: Monthly, Bi-weekly, Semi-monthly, Weekly.

geography.label: Location Geo
geography.notes: Geographic region: AMER, EMEA, APAC, etc.

business_unit.label: Business Unit
business_unit.notes: Division or business unit within the organization. "EMEA", a product line, a geographical region.

team.label: Team
team.notes: Sub-team or secondary department grouping. Alternative if department is not present.

entity.label: Legal Entity
entity.notes: Legal employing entity for multi-entity organizations.

flsa_status.label: FLSA Status (Exempt / Nonexempt)
flsa_status.notes: Exempt or Non-exempt under Fair Labor Standards Act. US-specific.

total_share_grant.label: Total Shares Granted
total_share_grant.notes: Total equity shares granted to the employee.

total_shares_vested.label: Total Vested Shares
total_shares_vested.notes: Number of shares that have vested.

annual_equity_value.label: Annual Equity Award Value
annual_equity_value.notes: Annual equity grant value in dollars.

voluntary_classification.label: Voluntary Classification
voluntary_classification.notes: Whether termination was voluntary or involuntary.

cx_capacity.label: Account Capacity
cx_capacity.notes: Number of accounts the employee can manage. Sales/CS metric.

quota_capacity.label: Quota-carrying Capacity
quota_capacity.notes: Revenue quota capacity for sales roles.

ramp_date.label: Fully-Ramped Date
ramp_date.notes: Date when employee reaches full productivity/quota.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.notes: Strategic initiative the employee is mapped to.

performance_rating_structured.label: Performance Rating (Structured)
performance_rating_structured.notes: Structured rating from a defined scale.

mobility_notes.label: Mobility Notes
mobility_notes.notes: Notes about employee's willingness/ability to relocate.

reviewer.label: Reviewer
reviewer.notes: Person responsible for this employee's performance review.

level.label: Compensation Level
level.notes: Job level for compensation bands: L1, L2, IC3, M1, etc.

employee.label: Employee
employee.notes: Employee occupying or participating in the assignment.

position.label: Position
position.notes: Position occupied or planned by the assignment.

reports_to_employee.label: Manager
reports_to_employee.notes: Preferred manager target when a human manager is known.

reports_to_position.label: Reports To Position
reports_to_position.notes: Fallback manager target for empty-org planning.

ref.label: Position Ref
ref.notes: Unique position reference. Often a code like POS-001 or an alphanumeric ID.

name.label: Position Name
name.notes: Descriptive name for the budgeted position. "Senior Engineer", "Marketing Manager", etc.

known_aliases.label: Known Aliases
known_aliases.notes: Confirmed alternate position names used for deterministic import matching.

position_status.label: Position Status
position_status.notes: Open, Filled, Frozen, Eliminated, Hiring, etc.

base_salary.label: Budgeted Base
base_salary.notes: Budgeted base salary for the position. Currency amount.

start_date.label: Budget Start
start_date.notes: Expected start date for the position.

end_date.label: Budget End
end_date.notes: Expected end date for the position.

department.label: Department
department.notes: Department the position is budgeted under.

location.label: Work Location
location.notes: Office, city or site for the position.

business_unit.label: Business Unit
business_unit.notes: Business unit the position belongs to.

job_family.label: Job Family
job_family.notes: Job family grouping for the position.

level.label: Level
level.notes: Job or compensation level for the position.

benefits_actual.label: Benefits Actual
benefits_actual.notes: Actual benefits cost for the position.

pnl_category.label: P&L Category
pnl_category.notes: P&L line item classification for this position's cost.

title.label: Title
title.notes: Job posting title as shown to candidates.

job.label: Job
job.notes: The job template this opening is for.

target_start_date.label: Target Start Date
target_start_date.notes: Target start date for the hire.

filled_candidate_name.label: Candidate Name
filled_candidate_name.notes: Name of the hired candidate once filled.

stage_entered_at.label: Stage Entered At
stage_entered_at.notes: Prefer ATS timestamps when available; otherwise derive from Timeline on current_stage.

id.label: Requisition ID
id.notes: Unique req identifier. Often like REQ-001 or an ATS tracking number.

name.label: Requisition Name
name.notes: Working title for the requisition; may differ from final position name

type.label: Type
type.notes: New Hire, Backfill, Conversion, Transfer, etc.

priority.label: Priority
priority.notes: Urgency level: Critical, High, Medium, Low, can also be numbers (e.g., 1, 2, 3, 4 or p1, p2 etc.)

owner.label: Owner
owner.notes: The recruiter or agency responsible for filling this requisition

requestor.label: Requestor
requestor.notes: The manager who submitted this requisition

position.label: Position
position.notes: The approved position for this requisition. Presence = approved; AFV effectiveDate = approval time.

job_opening.label: Job Opening
job_opening.notes: The active job opening for recruiting. Presence = recruiting; AFV effectiveDate = opening time.

position_request_status.label: Position Request Status
position_request_status.notes: Position request state: requested | rejected. Null = not yet requested. AFV effectiveDate = request/reject time.

is_on_hold.label: On Hold
is_on_hold.notes: Whether the requisition is paused. AFV effectiveDate = hold/resume time.

is_closed.label: Closed
is_closed.notes: Whether the requisition is closed/archived. AFV effectiveDate = close/reopen time.

target_start_date.label: Requested Start Date
target_start_date.notes: Target start date from the requestor; may differ from position.start_date

department.label: Expected Department
department.notes: Department the role will sit in.

location.label: Expected Location
location.notes: Expected work location for the role. Usually an office, "remote", or a city.

reports_to.label: Hiring Manager
reports_to.notes: Who the new hire will report to

justification.label: Business Justification
justification.notes: Free-text business case for why the role is needed.

base_salary.label: Target Base Salary
base_salary.notes: Budget guidance from requestor; position.base_salary is source of truth once approved

target_commission.label: Target Commission
target_commission.notes: Requested target commission. Typically for sales roles.

job_family.label: Expected Job Family
job_family.notes: Job family the role falls under.

level.label: Expected Compensation Level
level.notes: Target comp level for the hire.

manager_role.label: Manager Role?
manager_role.notes: Whether this is a people-manager position.

total_monthly_revenue.label: Total Monthly Revenue
total_monthly_revenue.notes: Derived: sum of included USD subscriptions' recurring_monthly_amount

first_subscription_date.label: First Subscription
first_subscription_date.notes: Derived: earliest start_date across all subscriptions

recurring_monthly_amount.label: Monthly Amount
recurring_monthly_amount.notes: Derived: sum of (item.qty × price.unit_amount) normalized to monthly

monthly_equivalent.label: Monthly Equivalent
monthly_equivalent.notes: Derived: quantity × price.unit_amount normalized to monthly
